title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning Case Numbers and Collection of Case Acceptance Fees for Pre-litigation Orders to Cease Infringement of Patent, Trademark, and Copyright Rights
keywords_en: copyright; patent; trademark; copyright act case; case numbering and acceptance
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Reply on the Issues Concerning Case Numbering and Acceptance Fees for Cases of Pre-litigation Injunctions to Stop Patent Infringement, Trademark Infringement, and Copyright Infringement

Fa [2004] No. 17

Shanghai High People's Court:

Your request "Report on Issues Concerning Case Number Compilation and Acceptance Fee Collection for Pre-litigation Injunction to Stop Infringement Cases" (Hu Gao Fa [2003] No. 293) has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:

In accordance with the relevant judicial interpretations such as the "Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning Application of Law in Adjudicating Patent Dispute Cases," cases concerning pre-litigation injunctions to stop patent infringement, trademark infringement, and copyright infringement constitute a new and independent type of case. To facilitate judicial statistics and accurately reflect the nature of such cases, these cases shall be uniformly numbered with the prefix "Jin" (injunction).

Regarding the acceptance fees for cases concerning pre-litigation injunctions to stop patent infringement, trademark infringement, and copyright infringement, since there is no disputed amount in such cases, the acceptance fee shall be collected in the amount of RMB 500 to 1,000 per case, in accordance with the provisions of Article 3, Item (5) of the "Supplementary Provisions to the Measures on Litigation Fees of the People's Courts" of the Supreme People's Court.

This is our reply.

February 16, 2004
